summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Dionysus killed with a thyrsus in the Gigantomachy.

story.text: Apollodorus names Eurytus among the Giants whom Dionysus killed with a thyrsus when the gods, aided by Heracles, destroyed the earthborn brood. The war as a whole belongs to the Giants together; Eurytus is one of those named in its battle roll.
This Eurytus is not the Oechalian king, the Epeian twin, or the Argonaut son of Hermes — men who share only the name.
